test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The establishment of Union Public Service Commission, State Public Service Commissions and Joint Public Service Commission falls under which of the following features of the Constitution of India?
solution:
**Solution: **The correct answer is** Federalism.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The establishment of UPSC, SPSC's, and JPSC's falls under "Federal" feature of Indian Constitution.
 
• The role and creation__ of all these Commissions are enshrined in **Part-XIV (14) of Constitution of India**.
 
• **Article 315 to 323,** deals with the establishment appointments role and participations of these commissions.<
